# Miguel Vázquez-Carrero

> PhD candidate in Economics at Universidad Carlos III de Madrid
> Academic job market: 2027–2028
> Website: https://mvazcar.com/

## Overview

Miguel Vázquez-Carrero is an economist studying the macroeconomics of firm
dynamics, competition, and resource reallocation. His research examines how
these forces shape aggregate productivity and long-run growth. He also
conducts impact evaluations using experiments and quasi-experiments.

## Research Interests

- Firm dynamics
- Competition
- Productivity growth
- Employment and labor-market outcomes
- Quantitative macroeconomics

## Current Research

### From firm demographics to measured TFP

With Andrés Erosa and Sevi Mora. Work in progress.

## Research Methods

- Empirical analysis of microdata
- Structural macroeconomic modeling
- Experimental and quasi-experimental methods
- Computational methods

## Teaching

### Mathematics Bootcamp

A five-day introduction to the mathematics used in graduate economics,
taught before the start of the program. Slides and figure codes:

https://github.com/mvazcar/math_bootcamp

- Day 1: Proofs and Choice Theory: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mvazcar/math_bootcamp/main/output/pdf/math1.pdf
- Day 2: Functions, Counting, The Real Numbers: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mvazcar/math_bootcamp/main/output/pdf/math2.pdf
- Day 3: Preferences and Utility: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mvazcar/math_bootcamp/main/output/pdf/math3.pdf
- Day 4: Optimization: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mvazcar/math_bootcamp/main/output/pdf/math4.pdf
- Day 5: General Equilibrium: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mvazcar/math_bootcamp/main/output/pdf/math5.pdf
